lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, appearing as nodes within a rectangular lattice pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from light specular highlights on the upper margin to dark shadow on the lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: At least five discrete, high-luminance spots are visible within the anterior portion of the first dorsal fin silhouette, though spatial clarity is intermittently disrupted by surface caustics.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin exhibits a ragged, serrated texture suggestive of minor tissue loss; a small notch is visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish, likely remoras, attached to the ventral region near the pectoral fin and along the belly.
